content:
alex: Kickoff for OrionPay trial — need to lock endpoints + success criteria today. @maria @sam @devon please weigh in.

maria: Top customer need is transaction summarization for dispute workflows. Must extract: merchant, amount, reason, and resolution suggestion.

sam: Also want a risk/rules signal layer: model should return a confidence score and risk flags (fraud, chargeback risk). Need low FP.

devon: Security heads-up: OrionPay requires SSO (SAML + SCIM), audit logging for 90d, and EU data residency. Hosted okay for quick eval but Dedicated EU or Private for production. We can offer transient cache in hosted.

alex: Draft success criteria suggestion for sales deck: 1) Endpoints defined and prioritized. 2) Latency SLOs (p95/p99). 3) Quality thresholds (metrics + eval set). 4) Security controls validated (SSO, retention, KMS). 5) Integration timeline & sign-off tests.

maria: Proposed endpoints and priority: 1) /summarize-transaction (70%) — extractive summary+actionable next step. 2) /classify-issue (20%) — bucket disputes. 3) /agent-assist (10%) — autocomplete & suggested replies. Percentages are relative business value for acceptance.

sam: For prompts/evals: we'll run 200 labeled disputes (holdout 50). Acceptance: classification F1 >= 0.88, key-field extraction exact-match >= 78%, and hallucination check: <5% critical hallucinations on a curated adversarial subset. We'll include deterministic seeds and adversarial prompts.

devon: Blockers to call out: SSO + SCIM completion (need IdP metadata from them), audit log export format (they want SIEM friendly JSON), and data residency proof. I'll confirm Dedicated EU capacity lead time (est 2 weeks) and KMS options.

jordan: Pricing Q from OrionPay: what does burst look like and difference between Hosted vs Dedicated? Quick answer: Hosted = usage-based with quotas; Dedicated = committed baseline + overage. Quantization & Optimize can lower token/unit costs (~20–35% depending on model). I'll follow up with a short pricing matrix.

maria: Integration timeline proposal: Week 0 (kickoff & API keys), Week 1 (SSO + basic API integration), Week 2 (eval run with 200 samples), Week 3 (tuning + acceptance). Can we hit that if Dedicated EU is available in 2 weeks?

alex: Sounds reasonable. Action items: @maria build eval set and one-pager for customer; @sam craft prompts and scoring scripts; @devon confirm Dedicated EU capacity & SSO ETA + upload security docs; @jordan send pricing matrix to me and SF by EOD. I'll sync with OrionPay Thu 10am. :calendar:

devon: Security doc stub uploaded here (internal): https://redwood.internal/sec/orionpay-pii-retention — includes retention policy + KMS options. I'll attach the completed security questionnaire once I finish.

sam: Small note for scoring: include a hallucination label and a severity score so product team can triage. Use the same scorer we used for the HelixPay eval.

maria: If nobody objects I'll draft the customer-facing one-pager and attach the acceptance checklist. Aiming EOD.

alex: Thanks — appreciate the quick turn. We'll present the draft criteria and timeline in Thu sync. :thumbsup:
